items.title: Moderna Soars 8% on Early Multiple Myeloma Data for Its Three-in-One mRNA Therapy
items.summary: Key TakeawaysModerna shares jumped 8% after its myeloma therapy, mRNA-2808, showed four confirmed responses among 11 heavily pretreated patients. The data shows Moderna’s mRNA can get the body to make three cancer drugs at once, though it’s years from challenging Johnson & Johnson, Pfizer and Regeneron.
